messages:
nora: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we agreed to convert the remediation tasks into runnable checks. Proposing a 10-day focused sprint: nightly regression job (promptset + quantized variants), a replay load job, and a chaos drill with rollback gates. Need owners and clear acceptance criteria.

kevin: I can own the nightly regression job. Plan: add failing prompts + the new quantized model variant to the nightly evals. Will add a matrix test for FP16 & int8 paths. ETA Fri EOD.

aisling: I'll take the replay load job. Prefer sanitized incident replay; if PII slows us, we create a synthetic generator that matches token-length and session inter-arrival histograms. Need infra ticket for ephemeral cluster and 48h metrics retention.

omar: I'll own the chaos drill & rollback gates. Proposal: run KV-eviction + forced model-fallback on staging, verify fallback correctness, and exercise rollout block if fallback rate > 0.3% across 1h. Dry-run next Wed.

kevin: Acceptance for nightly regression: no token blowups (token spikes < 0.1% of sessions), P95 latency < 250ms on quantized variant, and no model-fallbacks during the run. I'll include pass/fail metadata in the evals repo.

aisling: Example runner we can use for replay: `k6 run --vus 1200 --duration 25m script.js --out influxdb`. I'll include scripts plus a CI job that uploads metrics to the pipeline.

ops-bot: Card created: "PMT -> test sprint" assigned to nora - https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/999 (automated)

omar: Also adding a cost guardrail: if replay would exceed $X for GPU-hours, we should fallback to sample-based replay. Add that to the infra reqs.

nora: Good call — aisling include estimated GPU-hours and cost. I'll add cost guardrail to the board card. Standups Tue/Thu 10:30 for the sprint. Update the card with PR links and infra tickets. Ping me if you need sanitized traces access.
